SMARC 2.1 Embedded Cortex®-A55 Module based on i.MX 95 with Machine Learning Accelerator

The TQMa95xxSA based on the i.MX 95 supports with many features and an integrated NPU (Neural Processor Unit) with up to 2 TOPS and an IPU (Image Processor Unit) in the implementation of applications where artificial intelligence, machine learning/vision is to be applied. A GPU and several graphic interfaces are available for graphically demanding applications. For real-time and security the CPU is supported by a Cortex® M33 and Cortex® M7 controller.

text.text:
Features

  • Arm® Cortex® A55 based on i.MX 95
  • Machine Learning Accelerator 2 TOPS
  • Integrated Cortex® M33 and M7
  • High-speed communication via 1x 10 Gbit and 2x Gbit Ethernet (1x TSN), 2x PCIe and 1x USB 3.0 interface
  • MIPI CSI with ISP support
  • Low power consumption (typ. 6 W)
  • Integrated security functions

Starterkit STKa95xxSA set

The core of the STKa95xxSA set is the TQMa95xxSA module with a Quad Cortex®-A55 CPU. The components contained in the starter kit constitute a modular system enabling you to develop your own product ideas. Development of graphic interfaces can be started immediately using the prepared combination of closed display unit and starter kit that are matched to each other. To develop your own hardware you can use the certified and qualified circuit components of the starter kit in your own designs.
